anchors.quote: For new investment products that have tokenisation features and plan to seek the SFC’s authorisation, prior consultation with the SFC is required.

Prior consultation is also required for tokenisation of existing SFC-authorised investment products and/or material changes to the tokenisation arrangements of tokenised SFC-authorised investment products.

assumptions: The materialchange input is provisionally interpreted as referring to a tokenised SFC-authorised investment product. Its declared meaning does not explicitly include SFC-authorised status; this assumption does not create host validation.
The output concerns consultation required by these selected sentences only. The statement that changes may require prior approval creates no approval determination.
candidate.interpretation: Prior consultation is required when a new product has tokenisation features and plans to seek SFC authorisation, or an existing SFC-authorised product is being tokenised, or qualifying material changes are proposed. The last branch is conditional on clarification of the input's scope.
candidate.source:
```catala
scope Control:
  definition result equals
    (newproduct and seeksauthorisation)
    or existingtokenisation or materialchange
```
unresolved: Does materialchange apply exclusively to tokenisation arrangements of tokenised SFC-authorised investment products? The source requires that status, but the declared input mentions only an existing tokenised product arrangement. If not, the interface needs an additional status input to implement that restriction.
